Buyer checklist

When a custom chain makes sense

RWA and fintech teams should consider RaaS or appchains only when shared-chain deployment cannot meet throughput, compliance, fee, governance, privacy, sequencing or ecosystem-control requirements.

01

Rollup stacks

Confirm OP Stack, Arbitrum Orbit, ZK stack, Polygon CDK or other stack fit before choosing a provider.

02

Sequencer operations

Review managed sequencer, decentralization path, monitoring, uptime and upgrade controls.

03

Ecosystem integrations

Bridge, oracle, RPC, explorer, wallet, data availability and compliance integrations affect launch readiness.
